goal: Map existing project knowledge, relationships, authority and integration seams for persistent AI development coordination without changing production behavior.

evidenceLevel: G0 static inspection plus execution of the read-only PJC structural checker; no application behavior, hooks or production services exercised.

findings.statement: The introduction and Covenant support document-level expansion and scoped supersession of overlapping pillar definitions at the same time.
findings.consequence: An experiment must reject blanket retirement of the introduction but must not score every supersession statement as incorrect.

findings.statement: The PJC feature description states an empty v1 contract, while the inspected router and catalog contain six foundation capabilities. Empty business capability scope is separately qualified in the PJC.
findings.consequence: Record a stale current-state claim without declaring the whole horizontal-first direction contradictory.

findings.statement: PJC provenance records have origin and generic links but no first-class decision, external source locator, valid interval, supersession edge or execution-run entity.
findings.consequence: A coordination design needs an explicit mapping for these concerns rather than treating existing origin labels as verified decision history.

findings.statement: PJC check currently reports zero structural errors, 428 gaps and 113 bindings. Its revision freshness check compares the declared verifiedRevision with a caller-supplied revision.
findings.consequence: No semantic freshness guarantee follows from structural validity, and no content-sensitive invalidation is established by revision equality alone.

findings.statement: API conformance joins capability declarations, parsed card lists, selected document tables, contract and router paths, tagged test records, consumers and channel runs. It does not read PJC.
findings.consequence: A narrow reusable reconciler exists, but PJC narrative claims are outside its observed input boundary.

findings.statement: The conformance script calculates changedAt from filesystem mtimes of broad module implementation files and compares those times with test startTime. Channel runs are supplied as an empty array.
findings.consequence: Freshness is not commit or content provenance. A checkout or copy may change mtimes, and all declared open channels remain unproven by that input.

findings.statement: Scout composes filename search, documentation search and lexical code matches, caps filename results at five, and catches discovery failures before potentially returning no traces.
findings.consequence: No-results and unavailable-source states need separate typed reporting; this static code reading does not measure recall or actual installed-tool execution.

findings.statement: The inspected discovery/scouting services expose lexical, structural and impact tools but no PJC-aware context assembly was found by the targeted source search.
findings.consequence: An adapter could compose existing readers and retain their authority and limitations; broader repository search is still required before claiming no such integration exists anywhere.

findings.statement: The domain design method explicitly attributes its existence to an earlier API growing one ownerless contract per feature, with agents adding more.
findings.consequence: The historical rationale supports reusing domain ownership rather than deriving namespaces from screens or tasks. It is an author's account, not an independently measured causal result.

Introduces the inspected capability conformance implementation and tests.

integrationSeams.proposedUse: Read existing PJC declarations and project journey-scoped context without duplicating the catalog.
integrationSeams.constraint: Keep filesystem loading outside platform-neutral core exports; retain declaration-versus-evidence disclaimers.

integrationSeams.proposedUse: Expose per-capability gaps as an evidence source for an engineering context packet.
integrationSeams.constraint: Do not silently reinterpret card listing, policy unmeasured or channels unproven as accepted product intent or runtime correctness.

integrationSeams.proposedUse: Discover candidate files, code and architecture alongside explicit PJC links.
integrationSeams.constraint: Return source coverage and execution failures separately; measure retrieval coverage before claiming completeness.

integrationSeams.existing: domain cards and scoped governing documents
integrationSeams.proposedUse: Link human authority and decision scope into change analysis.
integrationSeams.constraint: Document freshness and timestamps cannot substitute for an explicit authority relationship.

resolveContext: Accept stable PJC and capability identifiers or a proposed match from natural language.
Return referenced source records, snapshot hashes, relationship classification, unknowns and per-source coverage.
Preserve partial supersession and expansion as separate scoped relationships.
createOrResumeChange: Reference existing product authorities rather than create a second requirements ledger.
Separate engineering procedure state from product journey state.
Preserve source fingerprints and original observations across restart.
recordActionDecisionEvidence: Keep agent proposals distinct from accepted owner decisions.
Record exact source locator, observed revision, scope and evidence limits.
Do not reuse an API evidence level as a blanket verdict on project intent.
evaluateNextActions: Validate declared prerequisite artifacts and source freshness mechanically.
Return blocked, partial, unavailable and unresolved states rather than successful empty results.
Do not treat structural validation as semantic acceptance.
identifyReconsideration: Index reverse bindings to changed files and scoped decisions.
Invalidate only dependent conclusions and evidence using explicit content fingerprints.
Use review-required for arbitrary prose unless a precise machine-checkable claim exists.
